# SparkFit

SparkFit is a fitness app for busy professionals and parents. It combines 15-minute home or one-zone gym workouts with simple macro targets, family-friendly meal plans, shopping lists, progress tracking and a 24/7 AI fitness and nutrition coach.

## Main pages

- Homepage and product overview: https://spark-fit.com/
- Pricing and trial: https://spark-fit.com/#pricing
- Frequently asked questions: https://spark-fit.com/#faq
- Free 15-minute starter guide: https://spark-fit.com/guide/
- iPhone app: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/sparkfit-15-min-workouts/id6754826325
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.spark.fit
